title: Viewer app architecture
description: File Viewer app uses message-based coordination instead of props
body: File Viewer — the tabs, and the pane they fill. This file is the join. It owns the two-region layout and the state that spans them — which file is showing — and nothing else. The tab model is `tabs/`, and what a file *looks* like is `viewer/registry.ts`. Four things used to be React props between a tree and a tab strip. They are messages now — `OPENED_EVENT` in, `ACTIVE_PATH` and `DIRTY_PATHS` out, `TREE_CHANGE` both ways.
